chunks: The day He will say: 'Call those you had called My compeers,' they will call them, but will get no response, and We shall place a gulf between them.
ai.seo_question: What happens when the polytheists call upon their false gods on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the ultimate futility of shirk by depicting the silence of false deities, contrasting with the responsive nature of the Ahl al-Bayt. The 'mobiq' (destruction) signifies not just physical ruin but a spiritual severance, emphasizing that polytheists will be left isolated in their error. This scene serves as a warning against attributing divine qualities to created beings, a core tenet in Shia theology.
